To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the design process is a process of learning, and that learning is a process of design.

the design process is a process of human learning, that design education should be considered an integral part of human learning, and that the design of design education should be based on the principles of human learning.
the quality of continuing engineering education is a result of the interaction between a number of factors that can be represented in a conceptual model.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a conceptual framework for the analysis of design education programs and with the development of an instrument for the evaluation and comparison of such programs.
the development of a conceptual framework to support the design and evaluation of continuing education programs in the area of technological design.
a comprehensive understanding of human learning and the development of a conceptual framework for the analysis, construction, representation, evaluation and comparison of design education programs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the quality of a program depends on the quality of the design process, and that the quality of this process depends on the quality and effectiveness of the means used to achieve the objectives, which are determined in a design process.
quality of a program is a result of the interaction between the educational objectives of the program and its educational means, and the way in which the program is organized and executed.

the principles of 'flexibility', 'adaptability' and 'integration' are the most important factors in the development and improvement of Continuing Engineering Education programs, in order to achieve a high degree of quality.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have tried to develop a comprehensive understanding of the nature of human learning, in order to develop a model for the construction of educational programs that can serve as a basis for the evaluation of the educational process and its results.
the design of continuing education programs is a matter of making choices and decisions in a complex and dynamic environment.
the quality of Continuing Engineering Education is a function of the quality of the design process and the design process is a function of quality education.

the quality of a program can be assessed in terms of the extent to which the program is in accordance with the intentions of its stakeholders.
quality of design education can best be achieved by a thorough understanding of the nature of design and the nature of learning.
